_note: One unit = one lesson path in five steps. Write 'God' (the Muslim view shows 'Allah'). Verses by ref only (shown from src/data/ayahs.json); hadith by id only (shown from src/data/hadith.json). 'about' lines are our own words, never a translation.

intro.muslim: When God commanded the angels to bow before Adam, every one of them bowed, except Iblis. He said: I am better than him. Watch what pride cost him.
intro.curious: In the Quran's story of the first human, God commanded the angels to bow before Adam. Iblis, the one Muslims know as Satan, refused, saying: I am better than him. Watch what pride cost him.

muslim.situation: A new student joins your class. They're struggling with things you find easy, and some people are laughing.

options.label: Laugh along: you're clearly better at this.
options.feedback: "I am better than him" were Iblis's words. Let's see where they led.

options.label: Offer to help, without making a show of it.
options.feedback: That's humility: knowing that whatever you're good at is a gift, and using it to lift others.

options.label: Ignore it: it's not your business.
options.feedback: At least you didn't join in. Humility goes a step further.

options.label: Help them, but make sure everyone sees how much you know.
options.feedback: Help given to show off is pride in disguise. The teaching explains.

quran.about: Asked why he did not bow, Iblis says he is better than Adam: made of fire, while Adam is made of clay.
Iblis is told to descend: it is not for him to be arrogant there.
The servants of the Most Merciful walk on the earth gently, and answer the ignorant with peace.
Luqman tells his son not to turn his cheek away from people in contempt, nor walk proudly, and to lower his voice.
The home of the Hereafter is for those who do not seek to be high and mighty on the earth.

hadith.about: Be humble, so that no one boasts over another or wrongs another.
No one humbles himself for God's sake except that God raises him.

insights.text: Iblis compared materials, fire against clay, and missed what mattered: God's command and His choice (7:12). Pride starts with "I am better"; humility starts with "everything I have is from God".
Humility is not thinking little of yourself; it is not looking down on anyone else (Muslim 2865), and God raises those who lower themselves for Him (Muslim 2588).

check.q: Why did Iblis refuse to bow?
options: He said he was better than Adam
check.why: "I am better than him: You created me from fire and him from clay" (7:12).

check.q: What happened to Iblis after his refusal?
options: He was cast out of the heavens
check.why: He was told to descend; it was not for him to be arrogant there (7:13).

check.q: How do the servants of the Most Merciful walk, in 25:63?
check.why: They walk on the earth gently, and answer the ignorant with peace.

check.q: What does God do for those who humble themselves for Him, according to the hadith?
check.why: No one humbles himself for God's sake except that God raises him.

check.q: What did Luqman tell his son?
options: Speak loudly so all can hear
Do not turn your cheek from people in contempt, nor walk proudly
check.why: Don't turn your cheek away in contempt or walk proudly; be moderate and lower your voice (31:18-19).

reflection.muslim: Who do you secretly feel better than? Do one kind thing for them this week, without telling anyone.
reflection.curious: When did you last think "I'm better than them"? What might they see in you that you can't?
